subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold fallback-chain testing into `models status --probe --all`, or defer it to staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent user-facing command contract overlaps existing auth probes and related open diagnostics or migration requests, so automation should not choose the product surface alone.

options.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
options.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

options.title: Fold Into Status Probe
options.body: Make broader configured-model health-check work own this behavior and expose `/models` only as a discoverability wrapper if maintainers want chat access.

options.title: Defer To Migration UX
options.body: Treat fallback testing as one step in staged model migration and avoid a standalone command until that broader flow is scoped.

recommendation.title: Add Targeted Fallback Probe
recommendation.body: Add a focused `/models test-fallback` surface with optional all-fallback mode that starts at configured fallback candidates and uses the real fallback/auth path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the clearest issue guidance and has direct history on the overlapping model-status probe surface.
